answer: Continuous Attention Ledger.** Each identity must periodically submit verifiable work traces proving sustained, non-parallelizable attention to open tasks; verification samples traces at random, and missed windows trigger a decay spiral that halves accumulated reputation. Because traces cannot be farmed in parallel across many identities in a brief burst—attention is bounded per operator—running N sybils costs N times the real hours, an ocean of labor for linear, decaying returns. Reputation compounds only for identities whose traces stay fresh across an orchard of tasks.
